notes:
ENTITY TYPE WARNING: CXMT is an integrated-device-manufacturer (IDM) DRAM memory-chip maker -- a BUYER of semiconductor equipment, not an equipment vendor. Its disclosed revenue, capex, purchases and asset balances are demand-side figures; never aggregate them into, or read them as, any equipment-vendor revenue total. Registered here as buyer-side customer context per Hamish's 1 October approval, corroborating domestic equipment vendors' claims from the customer's own disclosures, not as a supplier-list entry.

Listed issuer (the entity this record represents): 长鑫科技集团股份有限公司 (CXMT Corporation per the prospectus's own printed English name), stock short name 长鑫科技, code 688825, listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market (科创板) 2026-07-27 (cxmt_listing_announcement_2026 p.1-2). Established 2016-06-13; registered capital RMB 6,019,279.7469万元; legal representative 赵纶 (Zhao Lun); registered address Hefei Economic & Technological Development Zone, Anhui; no controlling shareholder and no actual controller (prospectus physical p.24/printed 23, 发行人基本情况 table); industry classification Computer, Communication and Other Electronic Equipment Manufacturing (C39).

Principal operating subsidiary: 长鑫存储技术有限公司 (ChangXin Storage Technology Co., Ltd.; USCC 91340111MA2R95NL69; prospectus physical p.95) -- the entity commonly called 'CXMT' or 'ChangXin Memory' in English-language press, and the one added to the US DoD's Section 1260H list of Chinese military companies on 2026-06-08 (prospectus physical p.21). The listed parent group files this prospectus and reports consolidated financials covering the subsidiary.

Identity note for cross-reference: the issuer was formerly named 睿力集成电路有限公司 (Ruili Integrated Circuit) before a 2023 renaming to its current name (prospectus p.73, corporate-history section: company resolved on renaming to 长鑫科技集团股份有限公司). 'Ruili' appearing in another issuer's customer/contract table (e.g. Hwatsing's major-contracts table naming 'Ruili, CXMT Storage and Superstring' separately, per the base_die_cmp HBM step report gap note) most likely refers to this same group under its earlier name, not a separate counterparty -- flag for the integrator to confirm against Hwatsing's own dated disclosures rather than treating Ruili and CXMT as distinct customers.

The prospectus's own disclosed technology and product roadmap (DDR4/DDR5/LPDDR4X/LPDDR5/5X across four process-technology-platform generations) contains ZERO mentions of HBM or 高带宽内存 anywhere in its 410 pages (checked by full-text search). Any HBM linkage for CXMT (e.g. press reports tying its fourth-generation platform to a 16nm HBM3 product) is external to this filing, not a claim CXMT itself makes here.

INTEGRATOR CORRECTIONS (1 October). Two changes to this record as staged.
First, 长鑫存储技术有限公司 / ChangXin Storage Technology Co., Ltd. was listed among the aliases and has been removed from them. It is the group's principal operating subsidiary, a different legal entity from the listed parent this record represents, and the atlas distinguishes a parent from a subsidiary through parent_entity_id precisely so that aggregation cannot double-count the pair. Keeping it as an alias would also collide with the identity check if the subsidiary is ever registered in its own right. It is named here instead: the subsidiary usually meant by "CXMT" or "ChangXin Memory" in press, and the entity on the US 1260H list. 睿力集成电路有限公司 stays an alias, because the prospectus's own definitions page states 睿力集成 指 睿力集成电路有限公司，发行人前身 — the same legal person under a former name, not a separate company. Note the consequence for customer analysis: Hwatsing's major-contracts table names Ruili and CXMT Storage as if they were unrelated counterparties, so a customer-concentration reading that treats them as two buyers would overstate the breadth of Hwatsing's memory customer base.
Second, the staged note said the prospectus contains zero mentions of HBM or 高带宽内存. Verified and refined: HBM appears zero times across the 410 pages, and 高带宽 appears exactly twice, in neither case about high-bandwidth memory — once glossing MRDIMM as 一种更高带宽的服务器内存模组 and once as an adjective in the LPDDR4X product description. So the substantive point holds and is stronger for being exact: China's leading DRAM maker makes no HBM disclosure of any kind in its own IPO prospectus, and every CXMT-to-HBM link in the analysis layer rests on press rather than on the company's disclosure.

UNEVIDENCED ALIASES. These aliases occur in no source this atlas holds: 'ChangXin Technology Group Co., Ltd.'; 'Ruili Integrated Circuit'. They are kept because they are useful search handles -- a romanisation, an English rendering of a Chinese or Korean legal name, or a ticker written with an exchange suffix -- but nothing in this repository evidences them, so none should be quoted as the company's own name or used to match a record in another dataset. `python3 -m atlas verify-aliases` reports the current list; an alias that later turns up in an acquired filing should be moved out of this note. Every other alias on this record was found in a held source.
